map.Bcrypt 密码哈希生成与验证：选择成本因子（rounds），生成 60 位标: Generate and verify bcrypt password hashes: pick a cost factor (rounds) to produce a standard 60-character hash, and check a plaintext against a hash in one click. All computation happens locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
map.为成本因子（cost factor，指数级决定计算量，10≈150ms、12≈6: is the cost factor (which determines the workload exponentially: 10 ≈ 150ms, 12 ≈ 600ms); the following 22 characters are the random salt and the last 31 characters are the derived hash. Verification needs no separately stored salt — it is embedded in the hash string and kept alongside it; password comparison uses constant-time comparison to prevent timing side-channel attacks.

map.口令 password 经 cost=10 生成固定 60 字符的哈希串，格式为: The password "password" hashed with cost=10 produces a fixed 60-character string, formatted as $2b$10$ followed by 22 characters of salt and 31 characters of hash (version $2b$, cost factor 10); the same password yields a different result every time because the salt is random.
map.把用户输入的明文与库里存储的哈希传入比对函数，返回 true/false；无需手: Pass the user's plaintext and the stored hash to the compare function; it returns true/false. There is no need to extract the salt manually — bcrypt reads the salt from the hash string itself.
map.bcrypt 为什么比 MD5/SHA 更适合存密码？: Why is bcrypt better than MD5/SHA for storing passwords?
map.MD5/SHA 是快速摘要，易被 GPU 暴力破解；bcrypt 刻意放慢（成本: MD5/SHA are fast digests that GPU brute force cracks easily; bcrypt is deliberately slow (the cost factor raises the workload exponentially) and enforces a random salt per password, resisting rainbow tables and brute force. It is one of the password-hashing schemes recommended by OWASP.
map.成本因子 rounds 越大越好吗？: Is a higher cost factor always better?
map.越大越安全但也越慢。一般 10–12 即可（单次要 0.1–0.6 秒）；过高会: Higher is more secure but slower. In general 10–12 is enough (0.1–0.6 seconds per hash); going too high slows logins and can be exploited for denial of service. Raise it periodically as hardware improves.
map.前端做哈希安全吗？: Is hashing in the frontend safe?
map.本工具纯本地计算、口令不上传，适合演示与离线校验；但真正存储密码仍应在后端用 b: This tool computes locally and never uploads the password, which suits demos and offline verification. Real password storage should still use bcrypt (or Argon2) on the backend together with rate limiting and anti-brute-force measures — frontend hashing cannot replace server-side security.
